notice: No crop rankings are enabled until locally validated, season- and region-specific profiles with references are added. Do not copy generic crop lists into this file as if they were measured suitability data.

required_profile_fields.soil_classes: List of model soil labels that local agronomic sources support.
required_profile_fields.regions: District/state names or Any, supported by regional sources.
required_profile_fields.temperature_c_range: Validated seasonal temperature range in degrees Celsius.
required_profile_fields.seasonal_rainfall_mm_range: Validated seasonal rainfall range in millimetres.
required_profile_fields.irrigation_options: Supported values such as Rainfed, Supplemental, or Assured.
required_profile_fields.water_requirement: Qualitative crop water requirement with a source.
required_profile_fields.improvements: Soil improvements supported by local sources.
required_profile_fields.cultivation: Basic cultivation advice supported by local sources.
required_profile_fields.sources: One or more objects with title and URL.

score_note: Scores are rule-based comparisons against configured profile ranges; they are not probabilities, yield predictions, or guarantees.
